source_contract: `YapfRoadVehicleChooseTrack` (src/pathfinder/yapf/yapf_road.cpp) is the road vehicle controller's entry to the road search. Its Rust port is the internal entry that road.rs calls once #964 removes the C++ route (`RoadSvc*` -> `YapfRoadVehicleChooseTrack` -> the native-test export).
reason: #965's plan adds the two Rust-internal entries in this pass and leaves calling them to #964, so they have no production caller in between; the native tests keep the exports, which take their own Input.
retirement_condition: When road.rs calls the function from its choose_track or find_depot site.

reason: #965's plan, decision 1: the seven _settings_game.pf.yapf fields RoadInput reads (max_search_nodes, road_slope_penalty, road_crossing_penalty, road_stop_penalty, road_stop_occupied_penalty, road_stop_bay_occupied_penalty, road_curve_penalty) join the settings catalog, so road_yapf::road_input reads them by field-sized load and #964 can delete RoadInput. One generated field per original setting.
existing_alternatives: The catalog had only maximum_go_to_depot_penalty from YAPFSettings; no Rust accessor reads the other seven, and a per-setting service would be a callback slot each.
retirement_condition: The fields stay while the settings table is native; they retire when Rust owns _settings_game.
